lanes.summary: GH-3147 (dense f64 SVD substrate, Golub-Reinsch + randomized) and GH-3148 (PCA rewired onto SVD + TruncatedSVD) do what their tickets ask. Verified the JAMA-style bidiagonalization/QR algorithm in golub_reinsch.rs (correct Householder reflector math, Givens rotation ordering, Wilkinson-shift QR step), the Svd wrapper's shape/index bookkeeping for both the tall/wide transpose path and the randomized range-finder (all dimension bounds hold: l<=r<=min(rows,cols) throughout), and the PCA rewrite that fully removes the SymmetricEigen/covariance path (confirmed via diff: no covariance matrix formed) and replaces it with SVD-of-centered-data, matching the receipt's claim. The covariance-guard case table and its anchored source-scan test are real (not vacuous). The nightly PCA-vs-sklearn beat test genuinely asserts ratio<=0.80 with no silent-pass path, and the CI workflow hunk exactly matches what the receipt describes (pipefail present, mirrors the GMM step, additive only). BEATS.md correctly flips the PCA row from LOSS to WON with the sourced measurement, matching contracts/beat-sklearn-pca-speed-v1.yaml. The receipt's two PARTIAL disclosures (scipy parity uses a norm-wise not per-sigma bound; randomized-SVD 1% bound is domain-limited, with the out-of-domain 1.8% case explicitly tested and recorded as FND-20260926-3147) are accurate and not overstated. No unwrap() introduced; census/contract counts match the diff (1837->1839, +1 kernel +1 beat-benchmark = svd-v1 + beat-sklearn-pca-speed-v1).
